source_files_inspected: src/ringlens/verify.py, ingest.py, cli.py, synthetic.py (symbol listing only)

implemented_capabilities.capability: Refund-abuse ring discovery on a FalkorDB property graph
implemented_capabilities.notes: Bounded two-expansion discovery from a seed refund: shared-device peer accounts inside a time window, with named-path queries so parallel edges stay visible and whole-graph device user counts computed independently of the candidate set (to demote shared public devices). Read-only via GRAPH.RO_QUERY.

implemented_capabilities.capability: Deterministic rule-based risk scoring (R1-R5) with per-rule evidence and mitigating context
implemented_capabilities.notes: Pure function, no I/O. R1 shared device, R2 synchronized rolling refund burst (3 accounts / 1800s, consume-window sliding algorithm), R3 repeated burst dates, R4 elevated refund rate with integer cross-multiplication, R5 shared address. Counts are distinct IDs, not path multiplicity. Points/thresholds live in ScoringConfig.

implemented_capabilities.capability: Immutable assessment snapshots, idempotent single-writer case publication (LOADING -> READY) and case reopen policy
implemented_capabilities.notes: Assessment id is a SHA-256 of group, input_revision, window, rule_version and scoring config; stored snapshot is re-validated against deterministic re-scoring on every read (tamper detection). Evidence nodes are content-immutable. Publication happens in one Cypher query after endpoint checks; lost-ack reconciliation reads the completion marker. Overlapping cases get requires_review flags.

implemented_capabilities.capability: Scoped human-review memory keyed on evidence-fact fingerprints with supersession and expiry
implemented_capabilities.notes: Each review covers only the fingerprinted facts it saw (records + measurements per rule anchor). compare_evidence classifies new assessments as ALREADY_REVIEWED / NO_CASE_REQUIRED / KEEP_CLOSED / REOPEN / ESCALATE based on which facts are covered by non-superseded, non-expired, same-rule-version BENIGN reviews and whether unexplained facts contain records not previously seen or a larger device-user count. Reviews never clear an account permanently.

implemented_capabilities.capability: Stale-input / data-revision guard and idempotent dataset import with provenance
implemented_capabilities.notes: Dataset/ImportBatch nodes with content_hash, mode (append) and status INGESTING/READY/FAILED plus a Redis-lock import lease; assessments recheck that the input revision and as_of horizon are unchanged before publishing, else raise 'Input revision changed; run a fresh assessment.' Demo ships data/demo/new_evidence (6 later refunds) to exercise the append/reopen path.

implemented_capabilities.capability: Bounded tool-calling investigation agent with graph-recorded audit and grounded output
implemented_capabilities.notes: Five typed tools (analyze_refund, get_evidence, get_review_context, apply_case_policy, get_case); assess mode cannot write; human review mutation is never an agent tool; the final text is composed from tool results by _grounded rather than trusting model prose. Runs are persisted as AgentRun nodes. Max 8 turns / 16 tool calls.

implemented_capabilities.capability: Synthetic demo-data generator with planted rings and ground truth
implemented_capabilities.notes: Deterministic seeded synthetic accounts/devices/addresses/orders/refunds for demos; all data is synthetic, not a real fraud corpus.

graph_models_and_cypher: Labels: Account, Device, Address, Order, Refund, Dataset, ImportBatch, Investigation, Assessment, Evidence, Review, AgentRun. Edges: PLACED, USED_DEVICE, SHIPPED_TO, REQUESTED_REFUND, FOR_ORDER, INCLUDES, HAS_EVIDENCE, HAS_REVIEW, ABOUT, HAS_BATCH, HAS_ASSESSMENT, LATEST_ASSESSMENT, OVERLAPS, REVIEWS_ASSESSMENT, SUPERSEDES. All Cypher is fixed, parameterized ($params) and read through GRAPH.RO_QUERY; label/rel names in write queries come from code constants (f-strings over SOURCE_LABELS/EDGE_SPECS only). Patterns: named-path MATCH p=(a)-[:PLACED]->(o)-[:USED_DEVICE]->(d)<-[:USED_DEVICE]-(o2)<-[:PLACED]-(peer), UNWIND+MERGE batch loads, publish-by-single-query with WITH/OPTIONAL MATCH/DELETE/MERGE, id(link) used for duplicate-link detection. No APOC, no GDS, no FalkorDB algo.* procedures. compose.yaml pins falkordb-server v4.20.7 (not 4.22).
algorithms: Rolling-window refund burst detection that consumes events to avoid window reuse in src/ringlens/scoring.py:refund_bursts
Two-hop shared-device peer expansion (frontier/visited sets, time-window filter) in src/ringlens/investigation_queries.py:DISCOVER_ACCOUNTS + investigator.py:investigate
Weighted rule aggregation R1-R5 to 0-100 score and HIGH/MEDIUM/LOW priority in scoring.py:score_records
Fact-fingerprint coverage test (subset-of-record-hashes plus anchor equality, user-count growth override) in reviews.py:_scope_covers/compare_evidence
Content-addressed assessment identity (SHA-256 over canonical JSON) and re-score-on-read integrity check in cases.py:assessment_key/_validate_saved
backend_interfaces: Typer CLI `ringlens` (src/ringlens/cli.py): doctor, schema-init, data generate/validate, ingest, verify, stats, paths, investigate, cases list/show, review record/history, agent run/show-run
Python library API only; no HTTP server or MCP server in this repo
agent_or_memory_mechanisms: Native tool-calling loop over five typed tools with strict JSON schemas and turn/tool-call caps, run audit persisted to the graph (AgentRun). 'Memory' is the human Review ledger: scoped to evidence-fact fingerprints, with SUPERSEDES chains, valid_until expiry and rule_version binding, consulted before every case create/update/reopen.
tests_present: tests/unit (11 files) and tests/integration (6 files); about 180 test functions by grep. Integration tests need a real FalkorDB (marker 'integration'), live-agent tests need provider keys (marker 'live_agent'); some tests shell out via subprocess for docker/CLI. Not executed by auditor.
security_findings: src/ringlens/import_queries.py:~12-35 - Cypher built with f-strings from SOURCE_LABELS / EDGE_SPECS constants; values pass as $rows parameters. Not user-injectable as written.
src/ringlens/graph_store.py:~85-125 - password handled as SecretStr, query text/params deliberately excluded from error messages, no automatic retry of writes. Good practice.
compose.yaml - redis-server started with --requirepass from env and --bind 0.0.0.0 inside container, host port bound to 127.0.0.1 only; password is mandatory (':?Set a password').
src/ringlens/agent_provider.py:13-37 - outbound calls to OpenAI/Anthropic using keys from env (.env); keys not hard-coded.
tests/integration/test_cases.py:107, test_falkordb.py:110, test_reviews.py:73 and tests/unit/test_synthetic.py:454 - subprocess.run in tests only.
No eval/exec/pickle in src/. No hard-coded secrets found by grep.
No LICENSE file; reuse permission is only the owner attestation.
duplicates_or_overlaps: Financial Fraud ring detection (shared device/address, refund bursts) overlaps other fraud-ring entries; its distinctive part is the case-lifecycle layer (immutable assessments, fingerprint-scoped reviews, supersession, reopen-on-material-new-evidence), which overlaps Evidence Drift and decision-lineage concerns.
evidence_drift_relevance: HIGH - reviews.py:compare_evidence plus cases.py:apply_case_policy implement fact-fingerprinted evidence, review supersession (SUPERSEDES), expiry (valid_until), rule_version binding, stale-input rejection (assert_current_input), immutable assessment history and reopen-on-material-new-evidence, i.e. a working evidence-change-to-decision-invalidation loop with human approval memory.

strongest_reusable_unit.why: Domain-light logic that decides whether a prior human decision still applies to a changed evidence set by comparing canonical fact fingerprints, honouring supersession/expiry/version, and emitting a REOPEN/KEEP_CLOSED/ESCALATE recommendation. Pairs with cases.py's content-addressed immutable assessment pattern. Needs light refactoring away from refund-specific R1-R5 rule names.
strongest_reusable_unit.external_runtime_needed: FalkorDB (via falkordb client 1.8, ro_query/query) and Redis lock for the writer lease; scoring.py and the fingerprint comparison itself are pure Python

strategy_rationale: Fraud-ring scoring (scoring.py, investigation queries) is a clean Financial Fraud pack for Kairos, and the review-memory/assessment-snapshot pattern should be mined as a reference design for Evidence Drift rather than merged wholesale because it is entangled with refund-specific models.
